title: The same MP and the Fayetteville bus killing
summary: Jones says the same MP later shot a bus driver who choked a black baby in North Carolina and was jailed at Fort Ord.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: But this trumpet player - and it's on record - this same trumpet player was the one that they transferred and sent to Fayetteville. They was on a bus -
North Carolina. You know where that is.

You know where Fayetteville is. He was the same one that was on the bus when a black baby was crying and the white bus driver went back and choked the baby - the same MP blew his brains out and drove the bus into the bus station and turned himself in to the MP's.
And then they put him in jail and when he came -

Yes. And when he came to Fort Ord he was supposed to ship out to go to fight. They just put him in prison and he stayed there for 6 weeks and we were sitting around drinking beer. As far as the world was concerned, they had took care of the soldier. That's the way it had to be.
